GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Generates a concise escalation case description for the human support agent when Aria transfers a diner. Summarises the restaurant, booking reference, issue type, and key conversation details.

inputs.definition: The conversation transcript between Aria and the diner
The name of the restaurant the diner was inquiring about — empty string if not mentioned
The diner's booking reference number — empty string if not available
The category of the issue: billing_dispute, diner_request, policy_exception, off_limits, or unresolved_intent
